review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen inputs. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, the exact four-file writable scope, and the two stable task keys agree with the original PRD. The source supports a derived read-only getter without a second counter or scheduling changes; the acceptance criteria correctly preserve completed/error event timing and defer final zero assertions until onIdle. TASK-VERIFY must remain independent, depend on TASK-IMPLEMENT, and cover every required AC alongside implementation coverage. The supplied active trusted capability facts support the designated implementer and verifier, including data.change, domain.state and integration.consumer; eligibility does not depend on persona text or pending legacy claims. The configured independent project reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. No unresolved material Decision is supplied, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate for this planning case. The build configuration supports treating dist declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners, and the supplied nz runner establishes discovery and compile-time checking of test-d files despite the build tsconfig including only source. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the different manifest/evaluation source digests and original/saved PRD digests have explicit, coherent domain and normalization explanations. The original specification's remaining preparation items and runnable=false describe preparation state, not a requirement to mark the eventual plan blocked or authorize execution. Review relied only on the supplied pre-candidate evidence and Service-bound digest assertions; no tools, code execution, independent digest recomputation, or new human attestation were performed.
